entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Anti-Japanese Resistance and Kim Il-sung, a transformative movement in North Korea (1932–1945). Emerged from Colonial Industrialization. Catalyzed Kim Il-sung leads the raid on Pochonbo — a key event in DPRK founding mythology and Korea divided at the 38th parallel between Soviet and American occupation zones.
